pipeline.prominence: (window max energy - window median energy) / window max energy
pipeline.artBox: emitted only when titleArt, artType, innerLeft, and innerRight are all detected

decision.why: 5 of 6 missing anchors are loose card warps (card IoU under 0.9). Their art edges are strong and sit outside the fractional windows because those windows are fractions of the background, not of the card. The two tight cards fail differently: Negate's art bottom is just below the art/type window, and Island geom-001's extended art bottom is far below it. Zero causing edges are a correct in-window line rejected by the 0.2 gate.
